segments: Farmer holding a letter titled "From Dad to Son" waves down a van.
The van takes the farmer's letter and drives up the hills in the distance while the farmer watches.
The van arrives at a prison on the hilltop.
A prisoner with a heart-shaped tattoo that reads "Dad" works hard at chipping blocks with a pickaxe. A prison guard stands close by, watching and blowing a whistle.
The same van pulls up in front of the prisoner and the guard.
A closer view on the prisoner, sweating while working. The prisoner gets startled when the guard hits him with a stick and turns toward the guard.
The guard holds the unopened letter, and the prisoner smiles when he sees the letter.
The guard rips open the letter and reads it while the prisoner watches.
The guard approves of the letter and hands it to the prisoner.
The prisoner looks at the writing on the letter, which morphs into a drawing of a bag, labelled with a fruit icon.

The view shifts, going into the letter, as two arms grab the bag. The scene zooms out to reveal the farmer holding the bag to distribute seeds, while his son, the prisoner, stands beside him. They're both smiling.
Closer on the son as he whistles and uses his garden hoe to make rows in the dirt. The farmer throws seeds into the rows the son makes. Both of them get tired from the hard work but are happy.

A tree grows from the dirt and fruits appear on it. More fruit trees grow from the rows of dirt while father and son smile and watch. The view zooms out, showing the scene as an illustration on the letter. The screen cuts to black.
